ModMetaData.name: A RimWorld of Magic (Continued)
ModMetaData.author: HUGINN (Original author: Torann)
ModMetaData.description:
[h1]Unofficial RimWorld 1.7 update of "A RimWorld of Magic"[/h1]
[b][ENGLISH][/b] Unofficial continuation of TorannD's "A RimWorld of Magic" for RimWorld 1.7. All credit for the original goes to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1201382956]TorannD[/url] — port of [url=https://github.com/TorannD/RWoM]the original code[/url], continued as [url=https://github.com/kelnmaari/RWoM]a fork[/url]. [i]If the original author wants this item removed from the Workshop, contact me via DM or comments — it will be taken down.[/i]
[olist] [*]HugsLib dependency removed — its duties (147 Harmony patches, update notes) are handled by the mod itself. [*]The JecsTools-family libraries (AbilityUser, AbilityUserAI, CompDeflector, etc.) are no longer bundled — the mod now depends on Zaljerem's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3312959701]JecsLite - A RimWorld of Magic[/url] (rebuilt for 1.7). [*]Fixed 1.7 regressions: LineOfSight default flip (autocast, Blink/Summon through walls, missing cooldowns), greyed-out ability icons, broken reflected shots, attribute patches (117 classes / 153 methods). [*][b]Multiplayer support[/b] built in — needs the 1.7 MP fork: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3820003322](1.7)Multiplayer-temp[/url]. Ability casts, cooldowns and gizmos are synced. [*][b]Isekai family compatibility[/b] (optional; see the Leveling limitation below): [olist] [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3657580708]ISEKAI RPG LEVELING[/url] — native integration by Jelly Creative. [b]Known limitation:[/b] the tested XML gate requires the exact name "A RimWorld of Magic" and does not recognize this fork's display name, so its RoM bonuses do not activate. Once recognition is fixed and verified, native bonuses cover mana/stamina capacity and regeneration, cooldowns and resource costs. No duplicate bonus layer is added here. [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3813394602]ISEKAI DUNGEONS ADD-ON[/url] — 4 magic gates: Flame Rift, Tide Rift, Bone Crypt, Demon Gate (C–S) with RWoM creatures; auto-join gate spawns, guild contracts and scrolls. [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3757560461]CREATURES[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3718568958]GUILD FACTION[/url] add-ons — coexist; RWoM creatures appear in dungeons and guild contracts. [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3800773705]RIM ISEKAI — Complete Integrated[/url] — clean coexistence verified. [/olist] [*]New character window (Grimoire): class levels, XP/mana/stamina bars with real regen rates, full spell list with descriptions and per-skill upgrade explanations, resources panel. [*]Debug menu: "T: Give Class..." grants any class to a selected pawn. [*]Bundled translations: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2882739907]Russian, Ukrainian, Portuguese (based on Nevelian's translation)[/url]. [/olist]
[i]Load order: Harmony → this mod; the MP fork goes before it. Requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3312959701]JecsLite - A RimWorld of Magic[/url]; do NOT enable the original JecsTools alongside.[/i]
[b]CAUTION! This port and its integrations were made with AI assistance — I'm not a C# developer and can't judge how well the AI handled it. If you don't use AI mods, please pass this one by.[/b] I fixed this mod for myself and decided to share it. If you have a problem, create a Discussion here — the code is on [url=https://github.com/kelnmaari/RWoM]GitHub[/url].
[b]This mod contains AI-generated assets. If you are able to help create proper ones, please reach out to me via private message.[/b]
